name: Transformer bushing-monitor alarm interface
aliases: substations Transformer protection and monitoring interfaces
summary: Receives the installed bushing monitor's declared condition or fault indication.
description: Receives the installed bushing monitor's declared condition or fault indication. Transformer monitoring interfaces connect physical sensors and protection calculations to the station's alarms and trip logic. Temperature, oil, gas, pressure and electrical measurements indicate different conditions and require separate interpretation.

In a substation transformer bay, a protection panel receives winding-current measurements and equipment alarm contacts. An operator can then distinguish an electrical protection operation from a cooling-system or physical-condition alarm. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Bushing-monitor output” at the input and “Bushing condition alarm” at the output. A monitoring alarm is not a complete bushing diagnosis.
